description: This file implements a handler for inviting team members, including permission checks, handling new and existing users, and managing invitations within a team or organization context.

methods.name: getOrgConnectionInfoGroupedByUsernameOrEmail
methods.description: Groups invitation info by username or email, retrieving organization connection info for each invitation.

methods.name: getInvitationsForNewUsers
methods.description: Filters invitations to identify new users who are not yet in the system.

methods.name: throwIfInvalidInvitationStatus
methods.description: Throws an error if the first existing user cannot be invited based on their status.

methods.name: shouldBeSilentAboutErrors
methods.description: Determines if errors should be suppressed based on whether the invitation is bulk or single.

methods.name: buildInvitationsFromInput
methods.description: Constructs invitation objects from input data, handling both string and object formats.

methods.name: inviteMembers
methods.description: Main function to handle the process of inviting members, including permission checks, handling new and existing users, and updating billing.

methods.name: inviteMemberHandler
methods.description: Entry point for handling the invite member request, including rate limiting and calling the main invite function.
